110        private boolean firstFrame = true;
111        public void advance(float amount) {
112                SectorAPI sector = Global.getSector();
113                playRepChangeSoundsIfNeeded();
114                
115                if (sector.isPaused()) {
116                        if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
117                                //RouteManager.getInstance().advance(amount);
118                                RouteManager.getInstance().advance(0f);
119                        }
120                        return;
121                }
122                
123                if (firstFrame) {
124                        firstFrame = false;
125                }
126                
127                float days = sector.getClock().convertToDays(amount);
128                shared.advance(amount);
129                
130                timer.advance(days);
131                if (timer.intervalElapsed()) {
132                }
133                
134                RouteManager.getInstance().advance(amount);
135                
136                Misc.computeCoreWorldsExtent();
137                
138                //updateSlipstreamVisibility(amount);
139        }

228        private void playRepChangeSoundsIfNeeded() {
229                if (deltaFaction != null) {
230                        if (highestDelta > 0) {
231                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_rep_raise", 1, 1);
232                        } else if (highestDelta < 0) {
233                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_rep_drop", 1, 1);
234                        }
235                }
236                
237                highestDelta = 0f;
238                deltaFaction = null;
239        }
240
241        
242        private float highestDelta = 0f;
243        private String deltaFaction = null;
244        @Override
245        public void reportPlayerReputationChange(String faction, float delta) {
246                super.reportPlayerReputationChange(faction, delta);
247                if (Math.abs(delta) > Math.abs(highestDelta)) {
248                        highestDelta = delta;
249                        deltaFaction = faction;
250                }
251        }
252

254        @Override
255        public void reportPlayerReputationChange(PersonAPI person, float delta) {
256                super.reportPlayerReputationChange(person, delta);
257                if (Math.abs(delta) > Math.abs(highestDelta)) {
258                        highestDelta = delta;
259                        deltaFaction = person.getFaction().getId();
260                }
261        }

273        @Override
274        public void reportPlayerMarketTransaction(PlayerMarketTransaction transaction) {
275                super.reportPlayerMarketTransaction(transaction);
276                
277                for (ShipSaleInfo info : transaction.getShipsBought()) {
278                        FleetMemberAPI member = info.getMember();
279                        if (!member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_ALLOW_EXCESS_OP_ETC)){ 
280                                SkillsChangeRemoveExcessOPEffect.clampOP(member, Global.getSector().getPlayerStats());
281                                SkillsChangeRemoveVentsCapsEffect.clampNumVentsAndCaps(member, Global.getSector().getPlayerStats());
282                        }
283                }
284
285                
286                
287                SubmarketAPI submarket = transaction.getSubmarket();
288                MarketAPI market = transaction.getMarket();
289                
290                if (!market.isPlayerOwned() && submarket.getPlugin().isParticipatesInEconomy() &&
291                                !submarket.getPlugin().isBlackMarket() && submarket.getFaction() == market.getFaction()) {
292                        CargoAPI cargo = transaction.getSubmarket().getCargo();
293                        boolean didAnything = false;
294                        OUTER: for (CargoStackAPI stack : transaction.getSold().getStacksCopy()) {
295                                SpecialItemPlugin plugin = stack.getPlugin();
296                                if (plugin == null) continue;
297                                
298                                SpecialItemData data = stack.getSpecialDataIfSpecial();
299                                
300                                InstallableItemEffect effect = ItemEffectsRepo.ITEM_EFFECTS.get(data.getId());
301                                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
302                                        if (ind.wantsToUseSpecialItem(data)) {
303                                                if (effect != null) {
304                                                        List<String> unmet = effect.getUnmetRequirements(ind);
305                                                        if (unmet != null && !unmet.isEmpty()) {
306                                                                continue;
307                                                        }
308                                                }
309                                                
310                                                if (ind.getSpecialItem() != null) { // upgrade, put item into cargo
311                                                        cargo.addItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, ind.getSpecialItem(), 1);
312                                                }
313                                                cargo.removeItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, data, 1);
314                                                ind.setSpecialItem(data);
315                                                didAnything = true;
316                                                continue OUTER;
317                                        }
318                                }
319                        }
320                        
321                        if (didAnything) {
322                                cargo.sort();
323                        }
324                        
325                        // not sure about doing this for major factions:
326                        // - it can mess with their flavor, unintentionally if the player just sells blueprints
327                        // - it can be a way to make their fleets weaker, by selling loads of blueprints for poor ships
328                        //BlackMarketPlugin.delayedLearnBlueprintsFromTransaction(submarket.getFaction(), cargo, transaction);
329                }
330                
331                //SharedData.getData().getPlayerActivityTracker().updateLastVisit(transaction.getMarket());
332
333                // moved below code to BaseSubmarketPlugin
334//              SubmarketAPI sub = transaction.getSubmarket();
335//              if (sub.getPlugin().isParticipatesInEconomy()) {
336//                      SharedData.getData().getPlayerActivityTracker().getPlayerTradeData(sub).addTransaction(transaction);
337//              }
338        }

350        @Override
351        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
352                
353                generateOrAddToDebrisFieldFromBattle(primaryWinner, battle);
354                
355                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
356
357                
358                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
359                if (!playerFleet.isValidPlayerFleet()) {
360                        float fp = 0;
361                        float crew = 0;
362                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(playerFleet)) {
363                                fp += member.getFleetPointCost();
364                                crew = member.getMinCrew();
365                        }
366                        shared.setPlayerPreLosingBattleFP(fp);
367                        shared.setPlayerPreLosingBattleCrew(crew);
368                        shared.setPlayerLosingBattleTimestamp(Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp());
369                }
370                
371                
372                for (final CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet : battle.getNonPlayerSideSnapshot()) {
373                        if (otherFleet.hasScriptOfClass(TOffAlarm.class)) continue;
374                        MemoryAPI memory = otherFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
375                        //if (!playerFleet.isTransponderOn()) {
376                        //if (!memory.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_LOW_REP_IMPACT)) {
377                                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_HOSTILE_WHILE_TOFF, "battle", true, 7f + (float) Math.random() * 7f);
378                        //}
379                        //}
380                                
381                        if (!otherFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_REP_IMPACT)) {
382                                if (!otherFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_LOW_REP_IMPACT) ||
383                                                otherFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.SPREAD_TOFF_HOSTILITY_IF_LOW_IMPACT)) {
384                                        otherFleet.addScript(new TOffAlarm(otherFleet));
385                                }
386                        }
387                        
388                        
389                        float fpLost = Misc.getSnapshotFPLost(otherFleet);
390        
391                        List<MarketAPI> markets = Misc.findNearbyLocalMarkets(otherFleet,
392                                        Global.getSettings().getFloat("sensorRangeMax") + 500f,
393                                new MarketFilter() {
394                                        public boolean acceptMarket(MarketAPI market) {
395                                                //return market.getFaction().isAtWorst(otherFleet.getFaction(), RepLevel.COOPERATIVE);
396                                                return market.getFaction() != null && market.getFaction() == otherFleet.getFaction();
397                                        }
398                                });
399                        
400                        for (MarketAPI market : markets) {
401                                MemoryAPI mem = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
402                                float expire = fpLost;
403                                if (mem.contains(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PLAYER_HOSTILE_ACTIVITY_NEAR_MARKET)) {
404                                        expire += mem.getExpire(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PLAYER_HOSTILE_ACTIVITY_NEAR_MARKET); 
405                                }
406                                if (expire > 180) expire = 180;
407                                if (expire > 0) {
408                                        mem.set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PLAYER_HOSTILE_ACTIVITY_NEAR_MARKET, true, expire);
409                                }
410                        }
411                }
412                
413                Misc.getSimulatorPlugin().reportPlayerBattleOccurred(primaryWinner, battle);
414        }

435        public static void markSystemAsEntered(StarSystemAPI system, boolean withMessages) {
436                system.setEnteredByPlayer(true);
437                
438                for (PlanetAPI planet : system.getPlanets()) {
439                        if (planet.isStar()) continue;
440                        
441                        MarketAPI market = planet.getMarket();
442                        if (market == null) continue;
443                        if (market.getSurveyLevel() == SurveyLevel.NONE) {
444                                market.setSurveyLevel(SurveyLevel.SEEN);
445                                String type = planet.getSpec().getName();
446                                if (!planet.isGasGiant()) type += " World";
447//                                      Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(
448//                                                      "New planet data: " + planet.getName() + ", " + type,
449//                                                      color);
450                                
451                                
452                                if (withMessages) {
453//                                      CommMessageAPI message = Global.getFactory().createMessage();
454//                                      message.setSubject("New planet data: " + planet.getName() + ", " + type);
455//                                      message.setAction(MessageClickAction.INTEL_TAB);
456//                                      message.setCustomData(planet);
457//                                      message.setAddToIntelTab(false);
458//                                      message.setSmallIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel_categories", "star_systems"));
459//                                      Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(message);
460                                        
461                                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel("New planet data: " + planet.getName() + ", " + type,
462                                                        Misc.getBasePlayerColor());//, new String[] {"" + points}, Misc.getHighlightColor());
463                                        intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "new_planet_info"));
464                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.INTEL_TAB, planet);
465                                }
466                        }
467                }
468        }

471        public static void addMiscToDropData(DropData data, FleetMemberAPI member,
472                                                                                  boolean weapons, boolean mods, boolean fighters) {
473                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
474                
475                if (weapons) {
476                        float p = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageWeaponProb");
477                        for (String slotId : variant.getNonBuiltInWeaponSlots()) {
478                                String weaponId = variant.getWeaponId(slotId);
479                                WeaponSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(weaponId);
480                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) continue;
481                                data.addWeapon(weaponId, 1f * p);
482                        }
483                }
484                
485                if (mods) {
486                        float p = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageHullmodProb");
487                        for (String id : member.getVariant().getHullMods()) {
488                                HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
489                                if (spec.isHidden() || spec.isHiddenEverywhere()) continue;
490                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NO_DROP)) continue;
491                                data.addHullMod(id, 1f * p);
492                        }
493                }
494                
495                if (fighters) {
496                        float p = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageWingProb");
497                        
498                        for (String id : member.getVariant().getFittedWings()) {
499                                FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(id);
500                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.WING_NO_DROP)) continue;
501                                data.addFighterChip(id, 1f * p);
502                        }
503                }
504                
505                data.valueMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageDebrisFieldFraction");
506        }

508        public static Set<String> getCargoCommodities(CargoAPI cargo) {
509                Set<String> result = new HashSet<String>();
510                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
511                        if (stack.isCommodityStack()) {
512                                result.add(stack.getCommodityId());
513                        }
514                }
515                return result;
516        }

518        public static void generateOrAddToDebrisFieldFromBattle(CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
519                
520                if (primaryWinner == null) return;
521                LocationAPI location = primaryWinner.getContainingLocation();
522                if (location == null) return;
523                
524                //if (location.isHyperspace()) return;
525                
526                boolean allowDebris = !location.isHyperspace(); 
527                
528                
529                boolean playerInvolved = battle.isPlayerInvolved();
530                
531                DropData misc = new DropData();
532                int miscChances = 0;
533                
534                List<DropData> cargoList = new ArrayList<DropData>();
535                
536                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> recoverySpecialChoices = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
537                
538                Vector2f com = new Vector2f();
539                float count = 0f;
540                float fpDestroyed = 0;
541                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : battle.getSnapshotSideOne()) {
542                        count++;
543                        com.x += fleet.getLocation().x;
544                        com.y += fleet.getLocation().y;
545                        
546                        float fpForThisFleet = 0;
547                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(fleet)) {
548                                //if (loss.getVariant().isStockVariant()) {
549                                boolean noDerelict = loss.getHullSpec() != null && loss.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_DERELICT);
550                                if (!loss.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.SHIP_RECOVERABLE) && !noDerelict) { // was not recoverable by player
551                                        if (!loss.isStation() && 
552                                                        !fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_SHIP_RECOVERY) &&
553                                                        !fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_SHIP_DERELICTS_IN_POST_BATTLE_DEBRIS)) {
554                                                recoverySpecialChoices.add(loss);
555                                        }
556                                }
557                                if (loss.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_BATTLE_SALVAGE)) continue;
558                                
559                                fpDestroyed += loss.getFleetPointCost();
560                                fpForThisFleet += loss.getFleetPointCost();
561                                if (allowDebris && !fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
562                                        addMiscToDropData(misc, loss, true, true, true);
563                                        miscChances++;
564                                }
565                        }
566                        if (allowDebris && !fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
567                                DropData cargo = new DropData();
568                                float cargoValue = fpForThisFleet * Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageValuePerFP");
569                                cargoValue *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageDebrisFieldFraction");
570                                if (cargoValue >= 1) {
571                                        for (String cid : getCargoCommodities(fleet.getCargo())) {
572                                                cargo.addCommodity(cid, 1f);
573                                        }
574                                        cargo.value = (int) cargoValue;
575                                        cargo.chances = 1;
576                                        cargoList.add(cargo);
577                                }
578                        }
579                }
580                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : battle.getSnapshotSideTwo()) {
581                        count++;
582                        com.x += fleet.getLocation().x;
583                        com.y += fleet.getLocation().y;
584                        
585                        float fpForThisFleet = 0;
586                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(fleet)) {
587                                //if (loss.getVariant().isStockVariant()) {
588                                boolean noDerelict = loss.getHullSpec() != null && loss.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_DERELICT);
589                                if (!loss.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.SHIP_RECOVERABLE) && !noDerelict) { // was not recoverable by player
590                                        if (!loss.isStation() && !fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_SHIP_RECOVERY)) {
591                                                recoverySpecialChoices.add(loss);
592                                        }
593                                } else {
594                                        loss.getVariant().removeTag(Tags.SHIP_RECOVERABLE);
595                                }
596                                
597                                if (loss.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_BATTLE_SALVAGE)) continue;
598                                fpDestroyed += loss.getFleetPointCost();
599                                fpForThisFleet += loss.getFleetPointCost();
600                                if (allowDebris && !fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
601                                        addMiscToDropData(misc, loss, true, true, true);
602                                        miscChances++;
603                                }
604                        }
605                        if (allowDebris && !fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
606                                DropData cargo = new DropData();
607                                float cargoValue = fpForThisFleet * Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageValuePerFP");
608                                cargoValue *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageDebrisFieldFraction");
609                                if (cargoValue >= 1) {
610                                        for (String cid : getCargoCommodities(fleet.getCargo())) {
611                                                cargo.addCommodity(cid, 1f);
612                                        }
613                                        cargo.value = (int) cargoValue;
614                                        cargo.chances = 1;
615                                        cargoList.add(cargo);
616                                }
617                        }
618                }
619                //Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocation()
620                if (count <= 0) return;
621                
622                com.scale(1f / count);
623                
624                // spawn some derelict ships, maybe. do this here, regardless of whether the value is enough to
625                // warrant a debris field
626                float numShips = recoverySpecialChoices.getItems().size();
627                float chanceDerelict = 1f - 10f / (numShips + 10f);
628                //chanceNothing = 0f;
629                //Vector2f com = battle.computeCenterOfMass();
630                
631                // in a battle that involves the player, recoverable ships are non-stock variants
632                // (due to being prepared for recovery; dmods etc) and so don't show up as possible recovery choices here
633                // which is good! since 1) they could've been actually recovered, and 2) they already contributed to player salvage
634                // replaced this with Tags.SHIP_RECOVERABLE tag in recoverable variant for cleanness
635                int max = 3;
636                if (playerInvolved) {
637                        max = 2;
638                        chanceDerelict *= 0.25f;
639                }
640                for (int i = 0; i < max && !recoverySpecialChoices.isEmpty(); i++) {
641                        boolean spawnShip = Math.random() < chanceDerelict;
642                        if (spawnShip) {
643                                FleetMemberAPI member = recoverySpecialChoices.pickAndRemove();
644                                String variantId = member.getVariant().getHullVariantId();
645                                if (!member.getVariant().isStockVariant()) variantId = member.getVariant().getOriginalVariant();
646                                if (variantId == null) continue;
647                                
648                                boolean noDerelict = member.getHullSpec() != null && member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_DERELICT);
649                                if (noDerelict) continue;
650                                
651                                DerelictShipData params = new DerelictShipData(new PerShipData(variantId,
652                                                                                DerelictShipEntityPlugin.pickBadCondition(null), 0f), false);
653                                params.durationDays = DerelictShipEntityPlugin.getBaseDuration(member.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
654                                CustomCampaignEntityAPI entity = (CustomCampaignEntityAPI) BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(
655                                                                                                 primaryWinner.getContainingLocation(),
656                                                                                                 Entities.WRECK, Factions.NEUTRAL, params);
657                                entity.addTag(Tags.EXPIRES);
658                                SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecialForBattleWreck(entity);
659                                
660//                              entity.getLocation().x = com.x + (50f - (float) Math.random() * 100f);
661//                              entity.getLocation().y = com.y + (50f - (float) Math.random() * 100f);
662                                
663                                float angle = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
664                                float speed = 10f + 10f * (float) Math.random();
665                                Vector2f vel = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
666                                vel.scale(speed);
667                                entity.getVelocity().set(vel);
668                                
669                                entity.getLocation().x = com.x + vel.x * 3f;
670                                entity.getLocation().y = com.y + vel.y * 3f;
671                        }
672                }
673                
674                
675                
676                float salvageValue = fpDestroyed * Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageValuePerFP");
677                if (Misc.isEasy()) {
678                        salvageValue *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("easySalvageMult");
679                }
680                
681                
682                salvageValue *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("salvageDebrisFieldFraction");
683                float salvageXP = salvageValue * 0.1f;
684                
685                float minForField = Global.getSettings().getFloat("minSalvageValueForDebrisField");
686                //if (playerInvolved) minForField *= 6f;
687                if (playerInvolved) minForField = 2500f + (float) Math.random() * 1000f;
688                
689                if (salvageValue < minForField || !allowDebris) return;
690                
691                
692                CampaignTerrainAPI debris = null;
693                for (CampaignTerrainAPI curr : primaryWinner.getContainingLocation().getTerrainCopy()) {
694                        if (curr.getPlugin() instanceof DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) {
695                                DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin plugin = (DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) curr.getPlugin();
696                                if (plugin.params.source == DebrisFieldSource.BATTLE && 
697                                                plugin.params.density >= 1f &&
698                                                plugin.containsPoint(com, 100f)) {
699                                        debris = curr;
700                                        break;
701                                }
702                        }
703                }
704                
705                if (debris == null) {
706                        DebrisFieldParams params = new DebrisFieldParams(
707                                        200f, // field radius - should not go above 1000 for performance reasons
708                                        -1f, // density, visual - affects number of debris pieces
709                                        1f, // duration in days 
710                                        1f); // days the field will keep generating glowing pieces
711                        params.source = DebrisFieldSource.BATTLE;
712                        params.baseSalvageXP = (long) salvageXP; // base XP for scavenging in field
713                        
714                        debris = (CampaignTerrainAPI) Misc.addDebrisField(location, params, null);
715                        
716                        // makes the debris field always visible on map/sensors and not give any xp or notification on being discovered
717                        //debris.setSensorProfile(null);
718                        //debris.setDiscoverable(null);
719                        
720                        // makes it discoverable and give 200 xp on being found
721                        // sets the range at which it can be detected (as a sensor contact) to 2000 units
722                        //debris.setDiscoverable(true);
723                        //debris.setDiscoveryXP(200f);
724                        //debris.setSensorProfile(1f);
725                        //debris.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", 2000);
726                        
727                        debris.setDiscoverable(null);
728                        debris.setDiscoveryXP(null);
729                        //debris.setSensorProfile(1f);
730                        //debris.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", 1000);
731                        
732                        debris.getLocation().set(com);
733                        
734                        debris.getDropValue().clear();
735                        debris.getDropRandom().clear();
736                }
737                
738                
739                DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin plugin = (DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) debris.getPlugin();
740                DropData basicDrop = null;
741                for (DropData data : debris.getDropValue()) {
742                        if (Drops.BASIC.equals(data.group)) {
743                                basicDrop = data;
744                                break;
745                        }
746                }
747                
748                // since we're only adding to fields with density 1 (i.e. ones the player hasn't salvaged)
749                // no need to worry about how density would affect the salvage value of what we're adding
750                if (basicDrop == null) {
751                        basicDrop = new DropData();
752                        basicDrop.group = Drops.BASIC;
753                        debris.addDropValue(basicDrop);
754                }
755                basicDrop.value += salvageValue;
756                
757                if (misc.getCustom() != null) {
758                        misc.chances = miscChances;
759                        
760                        float total = misc.getCustom().getTotal();
761                        if (total > 0) {
762                                misc.addNothing(Math.max(1f, total));
763                        }
764                        debris.addDropRandom(misc);
765                        //misc.getCustom().print("MISC DROP");
766                }
767                
768                for (DropData cargo : cargoList) {
769                        debris.addDropRandom(cargo);
770                }
771                
772                
773                //if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) {
774                        ShipRecoverySpecialData data = ShipRecoverySpecial.getSpecialData(debris, null, true, false);
775                        if (data != null && data.ships.size() < 3) {
776                                float items = recoverySpecialChoices.getTotal();
777                                float total = items + 25f;
778                                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
779                                        if ((float) Math.random() * total < items) {
780                                                FleetMemberAPI pick = recoverySpecialChoices.pick();
781                                                if (pick != null) {
782                                                        String variantId = pick.getVariant().getHullVariantId();
783                                                        if (!pick.getVariant().isStockVariant()) variantId = pick.getVariant().getOriginalVariant();
784                                                        data.addShip(variantId, ShipCondition.WRECKED, 0f);
785                                                }
786                                        }
787                                }
788                        }
789                //}
790                
791//              basicDrop = new DropData();
792//              basicDrop.group = "misc_test";
793//              basicDrop.value = 100000;
794//              existing.addDropValue(basicDrop);
795                
796                // resize and adjust duration here
797                
798                float radius = 100f + (float) Math.min(900, Math.sqrt(basicDrop.value));
799                float durationExtra = (float) Math.sqrt(salvageValue) * 0.1f;
800                
801                float minDays = DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin.DISSIPATE_DAYS + 1f;
802                if (durationExtra < minDays) durationExtra = minDays;
803                
804                float time = durationExtra + plugin.params.lastsDays;
805                if (time > 30f) time = 30f;
806                
807                plugin.params.lastsDays = time;
808                plugin.params.glowsDays = time;
809                
810                plugin.params.bandWidthInEngine = radius;
811                plugin.params.middleRadius = plugin.params.bandWidthInEngine / 2f;
812                
813                float range = DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin.computeDetectionRange(plugin.params.bandWidthInEngine);
814                debris.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", range);
815        }

852        protected Random prodRandom = new Random();
853        public void doCustomProduction() {
854                FactionAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
855                FactionProductionAPI prod = pf.getProduction();
856                
857                MarketAPI gatheringPoint = prod.getGatheringPoint();
858                if (gatheringPoint == null) return;
859
860                //CargoAPI local = Misc.getLocalResourcesCargo(gatheringPoint);
861                CargoAPI local = Misc.getStorageCargo(gatheringPoint);
862                if (local == null) return;
863                
864                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
865                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
866                report.computeTotals();
867                
868                // limit production capacity by available credits - the net coming in this month plus what the player has
869                int total = (int) (report.getRoot().totalIncome - report.getRoot().totalUpkeep);
870                int credits = (int) playerFleet.getCargo().getCredits().get();
871                credits += total;
872                if (credits < 0) credits = 0;
873                
874                int capacity = prod.getMonthlyProductionCapacity();
875                capacity = Math.min(capacity, credits);
876                //capacity = 1000000;
877                
878                int remainingValue = capacity + prod.getAccruedProduction();
879                //if (remainingValue <= 0) return;
880                
881                
882                
883                //Random random = new Random();
884                if (prodRandom == null) prodRandom = new Random();
885                Random random = prodRandom;
886                
887                WeightedRandomPicker<ItemInProductionAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<ItemInProductionAPI>(random);
888                for (ItemInProductionAPI item : prod.getCurrent()) {
889                        if (item.getBuildDelay() > 0 && !Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) continue;
890                        picker.add(item, item.getQuantity());
891                }
892                int accrued = 0;
893                
894                boolean wantedToDoProduction = !picker.isEmpty();
895                boolean unableToDoProduction = capacity <= 0;
896
897                ProductionData data = new ProductionData();
898                //CargoAPI cargo = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
899                //cargo.initMothballedShips(Factions.PLAYER);
900                CargoAPI cargo = data.getCargo("Heavy Industry - Custom Production");
901                
902                float quality = -1f;
903                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
904                        if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) continue;
905                        //quality = Math.max(quality, ShipQuality.getShipQuality(market, Factions.PLAYER));
906                        float currQuality = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PRODUCTION_QUALITY_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
907                        currQuality += market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.FLEET_QUALITY_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
908                        quality = Math.max(quality, currQuality);
909                }
910                quality -= Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.PLAYER).getDoctrine().getShipQualityContribution();
911                quality += 4f * Global.getSettings().getFloat("doctrineFleetQualityPerPoint");
912                
913                CampaignFleetAPI ships = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(Factions.PLAYER, "temp", true);
914                ships.setCommander(Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson());
915                DefaultFleetInflaterParams p = new DefaultFleetInflaterParams();
916                p.quality = quality;
917                p.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
918                p.persistent = false;
919                p.seed = random.nextLong();
920                p.timestamp = null;
921                p.blockHullmodsWithItemReqs = true;
922                
923                FleetInflater inflater = Misc.getInflater(ships, p);
924                ships.setInflater(inflater);
925                
926                int totalCost = 0;
927                while (remainingValue > 0 && !picker.isEmpty()) {
928                        ItemInProductionAPI pick = picker.pick();
929                        int baseCost = pick.getBaseCost();
930                        
931                        int count = Math.min(pick.getQuantity(), remainingValue / Math.max(1, baseCost));
932                        if (count > 0) {
933                                count = random.nextInt(count) + 1;
934                        }
935                        if (count <= 0) {
936                                accrued = remainingValue;
937                                remainingValue = 0;
938                        } else {
939                                int currCost = count * baseCost;
940                                totalCost += currCost;
941                                remainingValue -= currCost;
942                                
943                                if (pick.getType() == ProductionItemType.SHIP) {
944                                        List<String> variants = Global.getSettings().getHullIdToVariantListMap().get(pick.getSpecId());
945                                        if (variants.isEmpty()) {
946                                                variants.add(pick.getSpecId() + "_Hull");
947                                                continue;
948                                        }
949                                        
950                                        int index = random.nextInt(variants.size());
951                                        //cargo.addMothballedShip(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variants.get(index), null);
952                                        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
953                                                ships.getFleetData().addFleetMember(variants.get(index));
954                                        }
955                                } else if (pick.getType() == ProductionItemType.FIGHTER) {
956                                        cargo.addFighters(pick.getSpecId(), count);
957                                } else if (pick.getType() == ProductionItemType.WEAPON) {
958                                        cargo.addWeapons(pick.getSpecId(), count);
959                                }
960                                
961                                prod.removeItem(pick.getType(), pick.getSpecId(), count);
962                                if (pick.getQuantity() <= 0) {
963                                        picker.remove(pick);
964                                }
965                        }
966                }
967                
968                int weaponCost = 0;
969                ships.inflateIfNeeded();
970                for (FleetMemberAPI member : ships.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
971                        cargo.getMothballedShips().addFleetMember(member);
972                        if (Misc.isExtended()) {
973                                if (member.getVariant().getSource() == VariantSource.REFIT) {
974                                        member.getVariant().clear();
975                                }
976                        }
977                        for (String wingId : member.getVariant().getNonBuiltInWings()) {
978                                FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(wingId);
979                                weaponCost += spec.getBaseValue();
980                        }
981                        for (String slotId : member.getVariant().getNonBuiltInWeaponSlots()) {
982                                WeaponSpecAPI spec = member.getVariant().getWeaponSpec(slotId);
983                                weaponCost += spec.getBaseValue();
984                        }
985                }
986                if (!DebugFlags.WEAPONS_HAVE_COST) {
987                        weaponCost = 0;
988                }
989                
990                // add some supplies, fuel, and crew
991                int addedValue = (int) (totalCost * Global.getSettings().getFloat("productionSuppliesBonusFraction"));
992                int sCost = (int) Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.SUPPLIES).getBasePrice();
993                int fCost = (int) Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.FUEL).getBasePrice();
994                int cCost = (int) Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.CREW).getBasePrice();
995                
996                int supplies = (int) (addedValue * (0.5f * (0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f))) / sCost;
997                int fuel = (int) (addedValue * (0.3f * (0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f))) / fCost;
998                int crew = (addedValue - sCost * supplies - fCost * fuel) / cCost;
999                
1000                supplies = supplies / 10 * 10;
1001                fuel = fuel / 10 * 10;
1002                crew = crew / 10 * 10;
1003                
1004                cargo.addSupplies(supplies);
1005                cargo.addFuel(fuel);
1006                cargo.addCrew(crew);
1007                
1008                //accrued += remainingValue; // don't do that, only want to accrue when trying to produce something
1009
1010                totalCost -= prod.getAccruedProduction();
1011                totalCost += accrued;
1012                if (totalCost < 0) totalCost = 0;
1013                prod.setAccruedProduction(accrued);
1014                
1015                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
1016                        if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) continue;
1017                
1018                        for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
1019                                Random curr = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 11);
1020                                CargoAPI added = ind.generateCargoForGatheringPoint(curr);
1021                                if (added != null && (!added.isEmpty() || 
1022                                                (added.getMothballedShips() != null && !added.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()))) {
1023                                        String title = ind.getCargoTitleForGatheringPoint();
1024                                        data.getCargo(title).addAll(added, true);
1025                                }
1026                        }
1027                }
1028                
1029                
1030                // done with production
1031                
1032                
1033                
1034                if (!data.isEmpty() || totalCost > 0 || (wantedToDoProduction && unableToDoProduction)) {
1035                        if (totalCost > 0) {
1036                                //MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
1037                                
1038                                FDNode marketsNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS);
1039                                if (marketsNode.name == null) {
1040                                        marketsNode.name = "Colonies";
1041                                        marketsNode.custom = MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS;
1042                                        marketsNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
1043                                }
1044                                
1045                                FDNode production = report.getNode(marketsNode, MonthlyReport.PRODUCTION);
1046                                production.name = "Custom production orders";
1047                                production.custom = MonthlyReport.PRODUCTION;
1048                                production.custom2 = cargo;
1049                                production.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
1050                                
1051                                production.upkeep += totalCost;
1052                                
1053                                if (weaponCost > 0) {
1054                                        FDNode productionWeapons = report.getNode(marketsNode, MonthlyReport.PRODUCTION_WEAPONS);
1055                                        productionWeapons.name = "Weapons & fighter LPCs for produced ships";
1056                                        productionWeapons.custom = MonthlyReport.PRODUCTION_WEAPONS;
1057                                        productionWeapons.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
1058                                        productionWeapons.upkeep += weaponCost;
1059                                }
1060                        }
1061                
1062                        for (CargoAPI curr : data.data.values()) {
1063                                local.addAll(curr);
1064                                local.initMothballedShips(Factions.PLAYER);
1065                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : curr.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy()) {
1066//                                      member.getRepairTracker().setCR(0f);
1067//                                      member.getRepairTracker().setMothballed(true);
1068                                        member.getRepairTracker().setMothballed(false);
1069                                        member.getRepairTracker().setCR(0.5f);
1070                                        local.getMothballedShips().addFleetMember(member);
1071                                }
1072                        }
1073                        local.sort();
1074                        
1075                        ProductionReportIntel intel = new ProductionReportIntel(gatheringPoint, data, 
1076                                                                                                        totalCost + weaponCost, prod.getAccruedProduction(),
1077                                                                                                        wantedToDoProduction && unableToDoProduction);
1078                        ListenerUtil.reportCustomProductionGenerated(report, intel);

1086        public void reportEconomyMonthEnd() {
1087                super.reportEconomyMonthEnd();
1088
1089                if (TutorialMissionIntel.isTutorialInProgress()) {
1090                        return;
1091                }
1092                
1093                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
1094                FDNode marketsNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS);
1095                if (marketsNode.custom != null) {
1096                        for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
1097                                if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) continue;
1098                                
1099                                float incentive = market.getIncentiveCredits();
1100                                if (incentive > 0) {
1101                                        FDNode mNode = report.getNode(marketsNode, market.getId());
1102                                        if (mNode.custom != null) {
1103                                                FDNode incNode = report.getNode(mNode, "incentives"); 
1104                                                incNode.name = "Hazard pay";
1105                                                incNode.custom = MonthlyReport.INCENTIVES;
1106                                                incNode.mapEntity = market.getPrimaryEntity();
1107                                                incNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
1108                                                incNode.upkeep += incentive;
1109                                        }
1110                                        market.setIncentiveCredits(0);
1111                                }
1112                        }
1113                }
1114                
1115                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
1116                        report.computeTotals();
1117                        boolean useGross = Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_corruptionUsesGrossIncome");
1118                        float threshold = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_corruptionThreshold");
1119                        float exponent = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_corruptionExponent");
1120                        
1121                        float base = marketsNode.totalIncome;
1122                        if (!useGross) base -= marketsNode.totalUpkeep;
1123                        if (base > threshold) {
1124                                FDNode corruption = report.getNode(marketsNode, MonthlyReport.CORRUPTION);
1125                                corruption.name = "Corruption";
1126                                corruption.custom = MonthlyReport.CORRUPTION;
1127                                corruption.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
1128                                
1129                                float corruptionAmount = (float) ((1f - Math.pow(1f / (base / threshold), 1f / exponent)) * base);
1130                                
1131                                corruption.upkeep += corruptionAmount;
1132                        }
1133                }
1134                
1135                
1136                MonthlyReport previous = SharedData.getData().getPreviousReport();
1137                float debt = previous.getDebt();
1138                if (debt > 0) {
1139                        MonthlyReport current = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
1140                        current.getDebtNode().upkeep = debt;
1141                }
1142                
1143                doCustomProduction();

1146                
1147                //MonthlyReport previous = SharedData.getData().getPreviousReport();
1148                SharedData.getData().rollOverReport();
1149                report = SharedData.getData().getPreviousReport();
1150                report.setPreviousDebt(previous.getDebt());
1151                report.setTimestamp(Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp());
1152                
1153                report.computeTotals();
1154                int total = (int) (report.getRoot().totalIncome - report.getRoot().totalUpkeep);
1155                float credits = (int) playerFleet.getCargo().getCredits().get();
1156                
1157                float newCredits = credits + total;
1158                if (newCredits < 0) {
1159                        report.setDebt((int) Math.abs(newCredits));
1160                        newCredits = 0;
1161                }
1162                playerFleet.getCargo().getCredits().set(newCredits);
1163                
1164                
1165                String totalStr = Misc.getDGSCredits(Math.abs(total));
1166                //Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().showCoreUITab(CoreUITabId.OUTPOSTS);
1167                
1168                String title = "Monthly income: " + totalStr;
1169                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
1170                if (total < 0) {
1171                        title = "Monthly expenses: " + totalStr;
1172                        highlight = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
1173                }
1174                
1175                MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel(title,
1176                                Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), new String[] {totalStr}, highlight);
1177                intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "monthly_income_report"));
1178                
1179                if (total >= 0) {
1180                        intel.setSound("ui_intel_monthly_income_positive");
1181                } else {
1182                        intel.setSound("ui_intel_monthly_income_negative");
1183                }
1184                
1185                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.INCOME_TAB, Tags.INCOME_REPORT);
1186                
1187                
1188//              CommMessageAPI message = FleetLog.beginEntry(
1189//                              title,
1190//                              playerFleet, 
1191//                              highlight,
1192//                              totalStr
1193//              );
1194//              
1195//              message.setSmallIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel_categories", "bounties"));
1196//              if (total >= 0) {
1197//                      message.getSection1().addPara("Over the last month, your fleet, outposts, and other ventures have" +
1198//                                      " produced an income of " + totalStr + ".");                    
1199//              } else {
1200//                      message.getSection1().addPara("Over the last month, your fleet, outposts, and other ventures have" +
1201//                                      " produced expenses of " + totalStr + ".");
1202//              }
1203//              
1204//              if (total < 0 && Math.abs(total) > credits) {
1205//                      message.getSection1().addPara("Your expenses have exceeded your credit balance. If this continues for more than a month, " +
1206//                                      "some crew and officers may begin to leave, and other undertakings requiring credit expenditures may fail.");
1207//                      //message.getSection1().addPara(".");
1208//              }
1209//              message.getSection1().addPara("See the \"Income\" tab in the command screen for a detailed breakdown.");
1210//              
1211//              message.getSection1().setHighlights(totalStr);
1212//              message.getSection1().setHighlightColors(highlight);

1215//              message.setAddToIntelTab(true);

1217//              message.addTag(Tags.FLEET_LOG);
